decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established organic dairy range that remained visible after launch, it fits existing know-how and can be refined through the firm's own R&D, so management would likely keep it.

This mild sliced cheese is very near the firm's core cheesemaking capabilities and customer base, and with in-house R&D in a growing market the firm is likely to retain and optimize it rather than withdraw it quickly.

Sliced butter cheese also builds directly on the firm's established dairy and cheese expertise, so absorptive capacity is high and the most likely decision is to keep it on the market while learning from early sales.
